FY24: Revenue Rs 279.2Cr, Loss Rs 162.2Cr. FY25: Revenue Rs 326.2Cr, Total Income Rs 366.3Cr, Loss Rs 89.2Cr, Expenses Rs 454.6Cr. FY23: ~Rs 200Cr (Forbes FY22 data).
2000+ customers (2022), 1800+ clients (FY25). Named: BYJU's, Dunzo, Aditya Birla Capital, NIIT, Manipal, Amity, Olx, Kotak, Cars24, Zoomcar, Pepper India, Practo, Poonawalla, Godrej HF, Angel One.
CRM, Marketing Automation, Field Force Management, Sales Performance Analytics, No-Code Workflow Builder, Application Processing Digitization Suite. No AI-specific features confirmed.
HQ Bengaluru (Embassy Tech Square). Offices: US (Palo Alto), Philippines, South Africa, Australia, Indonesia. Employees: 1,063 (Inc42 latest), 1,300 (GetLatka Dec 2024).
Sudhakar Gorti left 2023, founded Astuto. No acquisitions found. US operations started early 2020. Series C2/C3 follow-on rounds in 2022.
No legal disputes found in any source. No litigation records identified.
3 founders updated
3 confirmed founders: Nilesh Patel, Prashant Singh, Sudhakar Gorti. Forbes mentions 4th person Sukhbir Kalsi but not in cap table. No Siddharth Gupta, Dhruv Raghavan, or Vikas Kaushik found.
